title: Add employee attendance summary API
spec: HR needs a single endpoint that summarises attendance for a given day without the browser having to compute it. Today the browser app recalculates this client-side on every render.
acceptance: GET /api/attendance/summary returns a JSON object for today by default.
It accepts an optional ?date=YYYY-MM-DD query parameter and uses that day instead.

The response includes: date, totals (a head-count per status: present, late, absent, leave, remote, unmarked), headcount (total employees), and attendanceRate (present+late+remote divided by headcount, rounded to 4 decimals).
It also includes byDepartment, using deptRates() from lib/store.js.
An invalid date (not YYYY-MM-DD) returns HTTP 400 with a clear { error } message.
Export a meta object with name and description, matching the pattern in routes/health.js.
